scope: Diagnostic-only public100-record groups in one transaction; no1024capacity, commit, actual CI cached-plan, production instrumentation or performance qualification claim. Forced generic plans of exact row-validator SELECTs; native guards and deadlines unchanged.
diagnosticPrivileges: Fixture-only SELECT on four private transition/attempt tables plus EXECUTE on immutable profile helper; no public API support claim.
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runtime_object_transition_attempt_id_operation_index_object_key ON truss.runtime_object_transition USING btree (attempt_id, operation_index, object_id, type_id)
CREATE INDEX runtime_object_transition_owner ON truss.runtime_object_transition USING btree (object_id, type_id, transition_id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runtime_object_transition_pkey ON truss.runtime_object_transition USING btree (transition_id)
CREATE INDEX runtime_object_transition_writer ON truss.runtime_object_transition USING btree (writer_xid)

queries.legacy_create:
SELECT t.transition_id FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t
  JOIN truss.runtime_object_attempt a ON a.id=t.attempt_id
  WHERE t.object_id=$1 AND t.type_id=$2 AND t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id()
   AND t.before_object IS NULL
   AND a.context->'mutationProfile' IS DISTINCT FROM truss.runtime_owned_profile()
queries.owned:
SELECT t.*,a.actor_oid AS original_actor,a.writer_xid AS original_writer,
   a.next_index AS original_next,
   CASE WHEN a.actor_oid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3
    AND a.writer_xid IS NOT DISTINCT FROM pg_current_xact_id()
    AND t.operation_index>=0 AND t.operation_index<a.next_index
    THEN a.result_count END AS original_result_count
  FROM truss.runtime_object_transition t JOIN truss.runtime_object_attempt a ON a.id=t.attempt_id
  WHERE t.object_id=$1 AND t.type_id=$2 AND t.writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id()
   AND a.context->'mutationProfile'=truss.runtime_owned_profile()
queries.latest:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT transition_id,writer_xid,after_object,after_keys,attempt_id,NULL::uuid registration_id,'ordinary'::text transition_kind FROM truss.runtime_object_transition WHERE object_id=$1 AND type_id=$2 AND writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id()
  UNION ALL SELECT transition_id,writer_xid,after_object,after_keys,NULL::uuid,registration_id,'rebind'::text FROM truss.runtime_catalog_rebind_transition WHERE object_id=$1 AND type_id=$2 AND writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id()
  UNION ALL SELECT transition_id,writer_xid,object_image,after_keys,NULL::uuid,registration_id,'key_backfill'::text FROM truss.runtime_catalog_key_backfill WHERE object_id=$1 AND type_id=$2 AND writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id()) t ORDER BY transition_id DESC LIMIT 1
queries.journal: SELECT j.value FROM (SELECT journal FROM truss.runtime_object_transition WHERE object_id=$1 AND type_id=$2 AND writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id() UNION ALL SELECT journal FROM truss.runtime_catalog_rebind_transition WHERE object_id=$1 AND type_id=$2 AND writer_xid=pg_current_xact_id()) t CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(t.journal) j
